appliedScenePlan.startFrameReason: maintain exact spilled poutine coverage, steam direction and barcode sticker position after the slip-induced cascade

appliedScenePlan.title: Clamp and Release
appliedScenePlan.event: Heat and steam from the gravy warp the mirrored column's reflections into delayed, extra faces of the plant; shoppers freeze at those warped reflections and a child's stroller rolls forward, tipping and scattering a shopping bag whose magazine (bearing an ISSN sticker) tumbles out and lands beside the plant.
appliedScenePlan.transformationMechanism: thermal distortion of reflections causing delayed visual feedback and crowd reaction
appliedScenePlan.consequence: mirrored column shows a warped reflection of the plant with extra faces; a stroller lies tipped near the plant, a spilled shopping bag with a visible magazine and ISSN sticker nearby, and a child's plush toy lodged between two tentacles
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: the magazine with visible ISSN sticker lies face-up beside the plant, the plush toy pinched between two tendrils beginning to twitch
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Wide shot: warped, steam-rippled mirrored column reflecting an impossible extra-faced plant; tipped stroller and spilled bag in foreground, magazine with visible ISSN sticker face-up next to the plant, plush toy jammed between tentacles; concrete floor, pulsing fluorescents and window light mix; frame holds the tableau of spilled shopping and warped reflection.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Steam lifts; mirrored reflection warps and shifts with a delayed echo of extra faces; stroller tips and the magazine skids into place beside the plant; the plush toy trapped between tendrils twitches.
appliedScenePlan.startFrameReason: re-establish full floor disturbance: mirrored column ripple, tipped stroller, spilled bag and magazine with visible ISSN sticker remain exactly as set

appliedScenePlan.title: Printed Seal
appliedScenePlan.event: The magazine's ISSN sticker peels partially, and its adhesive reacts with the plant's sap into a glossy polymer ring that contracts like a clamp around the lower tendrils; the ring tightens, forcing the plant to fold and release the paperback, fries and the plush toy onto the concrete as the tendrils draw inward.
appliedScenePlan.transformationMechanism: rapid adhesive polymerization and contraction of sticker adhesive interacting with sap chemistry
appliedScenePlan.consequence: magazine with visible ISSN sticker adhered over the barcode, its adhesive contracted into a ring that clamps the plant's lower tendrils, forcing it to fold and release the paperback and remaining fries onto the concrete floor
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: clamped tendrils start to fold inward and the paperback lies freed on the concrete where its pages steam and smear
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Medium-wide final tableau: plant's lower tendrils bound by a glossy adhesive ring at the magazine, tendrils folding inward; paperback and fries splayed on the concrete, steam rising, mirrored column reflecting the tightened clamp; pulsing fluorescents and window spill remain; frame settles imperfectly.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: ISSN sticker peels and glows as adhesive cures into a tightening ring; tendrils contract, the plant folds and ejects the paperback and fries; steam and sap bead and run across concrete as reflections tremble.
appliedScenePlan.startFrameReason: begin with the adhesive ring clamping tendrils and paperback freed on the concrete exactly where the contraction left them
